impact.text: This is a permanent, loss-of-funds (final depositor shuts down the pool).

precondition_sources.text: The withdrawing user controls 100% of the outstanding gHYBR supply (e.g., the first depositor or the last remaining LP).
At withdraw time the user owns 100% of the contract's veNFT value.

intent_sources.text: The user's gHYBR shares must not be burned unless the withdrawal completes and the underlying HYBR can be claimed.
